questions.question: What happens when you try to buy alcohol at a self-checkout and you're clearly underage?
options: It calls over a staff member for ID check
questions.answer: It calls over a staff member for ID check - Self-checkouts still need human oversight for age-restricted items.

questions.question: Why do some people talk to self-checkout machines like they're alive?
options: It’s a weird human habit called 'anthropomorphism'
questions.answer: It’s a weird human habit called 'anthropomorphism' - We naturally treat machines like people, especially when they act up.

questions.question: Which of these has been replaced by automation in some hotels?
questions.answer: Front desk staff - Some hotels, especially in Japan, have robot receptionists.

questions.question: What hilarious error appeared in a UK self-checkout system?
options: It gave everyone free ice cream
It said 'unexpected unicorn in the bagging area'
It started speaking in pirate voice
questions.answer: It said 'unexpected unicorn in the bagging area' - A cheeky programmer slipped in a joke.

questions.question: Which is a real reason people avoid using self-checkouts?
options: They think the machine judges them
They can’t find the 'checkout with style' button
questions.answer: They miss chatting with cashiers - Some shoppers enjoy the social aspect of traditional checkouts.

questions.question: What did a grocery chain in Sweden add to make checkouts more enjoyable?
questions.answer: A 'slow checkout lane' for chatting - Perfect for people who want to take their time and connect with others.

questions.question: What odd thing happened when AI was used to monitor for shoplifters?
options: It caught a thief and apologized
questions.answer: It accused mannequins - The system flagged them as suspicious because they weren’t moving.

questions.question: Which fast food type is most likely to use AI to take your order?
questions.answer: Burger joints - AI is increasingly used in drive-thrus to speed up service.
